# llms.txt — https://csoai.org
# Council of AI (CSOAI LTD, UK 16939677)
# Independent measurement body for AI behaviour.
# We measure, sign, and re-attest. Everyone can check.
# Verified measurement credential — never certification. Not a notified body.

## Canonical surfaces
- [Home](https://csoai.org): measurement body landing
- [Council site](https://councilof.ai): the human application
- [Signed scoreboard](https://councilof.ai/gspc-scoreboard)
- [Verify](https://councilof.ai/verify): free, loginless, client-side
- [Arena](https://csoai.org/arenas): measured AI-vs-AI spectator
- [GSPC API](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc): live axis register (13 measured of 14)
- [Latest signed receipt](https://csoai.org/api/receipts/latest): one full signed artifact + offline verification steps
- [Arena evidence feed](https://csoai.org/api/arena/rounds.jsonl): live measured rounds (NDJSON)

## Machine identity
- DID: did:web:csoai.org → https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json
- Agent card (A2A): https://csoai.org/.well-known/agent-card.json
- API catalog (RFC 9727): https://csoai.org/.well-known/api-catalog
- MCP manifest: https://csoai.org/.well-known/mcp.json
- Verification schema: https://csoai.org/verification.schema.json
- Sealed bank manifest: https://csoai.org/banks-manifest.json
- Canonical citations: https://csoai.org/CANONICAL-DOIS.md

## What we are not
- Not a certification body
- Not a notified body
- No money in either direction with anything we rank
- Legacy internal codenames are not public chrome; historical counts in old caches are superseded by the signed manifest
